blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Active multimodal agents use visual tools to acquire task-relevant evidence while reasoning.
Although reinforcement learning samples multiple interaction trajectories per input, outcome-based objectives primarily use the group to estimate scalar advantages, leaving complementary visual discoveries underused.
We introduce VISTA , which internalizes collective visual experience through on-policy distillation by turning observations from same-input rollouts into shared supervision. Collective visual experience distillation ( CVED ) organizes these observations with their interaction context and aligns them with individual decisions, while heterogeneity-aware policy improvement ( HAPI ) reinforces successful trajectories and provides experience-guided distillation for unsuccessful attempts.
An experience-conditioned teacher evaluates the student’s sampled response prefixes, allowing discoveries from one trajectory to guide learning in another without replacing the student’s original history or generating new target trajectories.
The trained agent retains its visual tools and acts using its own interaction history. VISTA achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated active multimodal agents of comparable size and consistently outperforms same-backbone training baselines across fine-grained perception and general reasoning tasks, demonstrating the value of collective experience for active multimodal learning.
blocks.zh:
积极的多式联运代理人在推理时使用视觉工具获取与任务相关的证据.
虽然强化学习对每次输入的多个相互作用轨迹进行了样本,但基于结果的目标主要利用该组来估计斯卡尔的优势,使得互补的视觉发现被利用不足.
我们引入了VISTA,它通过政策提炼将集体视觉经验内部化,将同投入推出的观察转化为共同监督。 集体视觉经验衍射(CVED)用其相互作用的背景来组织这些观测,并将其与个别决定相配合,而异质感-意识政策改进(HAPI)则强化成功的轨迹,并为失败的尝试提供经验指导衍射.
一个经验条件好的老师评价学生的抽样反应前缀,允许从一个轨迹中发现来指导另一个轨迹中的学习,而不取代学生的原始历史或产生新的目标轨迹.
训练有素的特工保留自己的视觉工具和行为,使用自己的互动历史. VISTA在规模相当的经评价的活跃多式联运代理商中取得了最强的平均业绩,在精细的认知和一般推理任务中,其业绩始终高于同一背骨培训基线,表明集体经验对活跃的多式联运学习的价值。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multimodal agents are moving beyond answering questions from a fixed image toward actively acquiring the evidence required to solve them.
They can inspect local regions with crop and zoom tools, transform returned views, and chain visual actions with reasoning or search ( Wu and Xie, 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2024 ) .
This setting makes visual interaction part of the policy.
Success depends not only on what the model knows, but also on whether it acquires useful evidence and incorporates it into subsequent decisions.
Reinforcement learning has therefore become a natural training paradigm for active multimodal agents.
Recent systems sample multiple tool-using trajectories for each image–question pair and use verifiable outcomes to reinforce effective behavior ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Shao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
多式联运代理人正在超越回答问题的范围,从固定的形象转向积极获取解决问题所需的证据。
他们可以使用作物和缩放工具检查局部地区,转换返回的视图,并用推理或搜索的链式视觉动作(Wu and Xie,2023;Hu等人,2024;沈等人,2024).
这种设置使得视觉互动成为了政策的一部分.
成功不仅取决于模型知道什么,还取决于它是否获得有用的证据并将其纳入随后的决定中.
因此,强化学习已成为积极多式联运代理商的自然培训模式。
近期的系统对每个图像的多种工具使用轨迹进行了抽样——问对并使用可核实的结果强化有效行为(郑等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年;王等人,2025年a;刘等人,2025年;杨等人,2026年b;肖等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
However, current outcome-based objectives use a rollout group primarily as a source of scalar comparisons.
Once relative advantages have been computed, the visual discoveries made by one trajectory are not directly available to the others: a trajectory that finds a decisive region can teach its peers only through a reward difference.
This creates an experience-utilization gap .
The group may collectively contain the evidence needed to solve a task, including useful observations from partial attempts, yet most of this task-specific experience disappears after the policy update.
On-policy distillation offers a natural way to narrow this gap by evaluating a student’s response under an enhanced context and thereby providing denser token-level supervision ( Penaloza et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) .
Visual approaches derive supervision from privileged regional views, generated visual thoughts, or contrasts between visual inputs ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,目前基于成果的目标主要利用一个推出小组作为进行平面比较的来源。
一旦计算了相对优势,一个轨迹所作的视觉发现就无法直接提供给其他轨迹:一个找到决定性区域的轨迹只能通过奖励差异来教导同伴。
这就造成了经验利用差距。
该小组可能集体包含解决某项任务所需的证据,包括部分尝试的有用意见,然而,大多数这种具体任务的经验在政策更新后消失。
政策上的提炼为缩小这一差距提供了一个自然的途径,方法是在强化的背景下评估学生的反应,从而提供更密集的象征性监督(Penoroza等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年a年)。
视觉方法源于特权区域观点的监督,产生视觉思想,或视觉投入之间的对比(袁等人,2026年;蔡等人,2026年;李等人,2026年;梁等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Applying visual OPD to active multimodal agents nevertheless leaves two problems unresolved.
The first concerns the source of privileged supervision.
Existing approaches enrich teacher predictions through privileged context or visual contrast, but leave open how to exploit complementary evidence discovered across the agent’s own same-input interaction rollouts.
Turning these discoveries into supervision requires organizing their interaction context and aligning them with the student’s current decision.
The second problem concerns the allocation of supervision across heterogeneous trajectories.
A failed attempt may contain a useful observation despite reaching an incorrect answer, whereas a successful attempt may benefit more from reinforcing its behavior than from matching a teacher’s preferences.
Final success therefore does not fully characterize the value of a trajectory’s experience, and uniform distillation does not distinguish behavioral reinforcement from corrective guidance.
Effective learning therefore requires both a shared representation of the group’s experience and a policy-improvement strategy that respects the heterogeneous roles of its trajectories.
blocks.zh:
将视觉的OPD应用于活跃的多式联运代理商仍然有两个问题没有解决。
第一个问题涉及特权监督的来源。
现有方法通过特殊背景或视觉对比丰富了教师的预测,但留下了如何利用在代理商自身同投入互动推出过程中发现的补充证据的空洞余地。
将这些发现转化为监督,需要组织互动环境,并与学生目前的决定保持一致。
第二个问题涉及不同轨迹的监督分配。
失败的尝试可能包含一个有用的观察,尽管得到的答案不正确,而成功的尝试可能从强化其行为而不是从匹配教师的偏好中得到更多的好处。
因此,最终的成功并不能充分说明轨迹经验的价值,统一的衍射并不能区分行为强化和矫正指导。
因此,有效的学习既需要共同代表该群体的经验,也需要制定尊重其各种轨道作用的政策改进战略。

blocks.en:
These observations motivate VISTA.
Our first principle is to distill the shared evidence produced by the rollout group rather than treating trajectories as independent reward samples.
We implement this principle with collective visual experience distillation ( CVED ), which organizes the group’s visual artifacts and interaction context into training-only privilege and aligns that context with each student’s original history.
Our second principle is to improve the policy according to the heterogeneous roles of different trajectories.
We implement it with heterogeneity-aware policy improvement ( HAPI ): successful trajectories receive reward-aligned RLVR updates, while unsuccessful trajectories receive OPSD guidance from the experience-conditioned teacher.
The teacher evaluates the exact response prefix sampled by the student rather than generating a replacement trajectory.
The student remains conditioned only on its own interaction history, and the rollout group, teacher, and collective context are removed at deployment.
VISTA therefore transfers useful discoveries across trajectories during training while preserving the original active-agent interface at inference time.
blocks.zh:
这些观察促使VISTA.
我们的第一项原则是提炼推出小组提出的共同证据,而不是将轨迹作为独立的奖励样品。
我们通过集体视觉经验提炼(CVED)来实施这一原则,将小组的视觉文物和互动环境组织为只培训的特权,并使这种背景与每个学生的原始历史相一致。
我们的第二项原则是根据不同轨迹的不同作用改进政策。
我们以异质感知政策改进(HAPI):成功的轨迹会得到对等的RLVR更新,而不成功的轨迹会得到经验型教师的OPSD指导.
老师评价学生所采样的确切响应前缀,而不是产生替换轨迹.
学生仅以自己的互动历史为条件,在部署时取消推出小组、教师和集体背景。
因此,VISTA在训练期间将有用的发现跨轨转移,同时在推断时间保留原有的主动剂界面.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Mechanism. We identify an experience-utilization gap in active multimodal learning, where outcome-based supervision underuses complementary visual discoveries and overlooks the distinction between trajectory success and informational value. • Methodology. We introduce VISTA , combining CVED for decision-aligned experience distillation with HAPI for reinforcing successful trajectories and guiding unsuccessful ones through collective visual experience. • Performance. VISTA leads the evaluated active multimodal agents of comparable size in average visual-reasoning accuracy and improves over same-backbone training baselines across fine-grained perception and general reasoning tasks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables multimodal agents to acquire evidence through visual tools rather than reason only over a fixed image ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) .
VTool-R1 and Thyme extend this paradigm to executable image operations, while DeepEyesV2 develops broader multimodal tool use ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Hong et al., 2025 ) .
Further work improves reasoning–action alignment and scales interaction depth ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Lai et al., 2025 ) .
These studies primarily improve how agents explore and learn from task feedback. VISTA addresses the complementary problem of reusing what exploration discovers: visual observations from same-input rollouts become shared supervision for the agent’s decisions.
blocks.zh:
强化学习,并给予可核查的奖励,使多式联运代理商能够通过视觉工具获取证据,而不是仅仅通过固定形象获取理由(郑等人,2025年;王等人,2025年a;刘等人,2025年)。
工具-R1和 Thyme将这一范式扩展至可执行的图像操作,DeepEyesV2开发了更广泛的多式联运工具使用(Wu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a; Hong等人, 2025 ).
进一步的工作改进了推理-行动调整和尺度互动深度(Yang等人,2026b;Lai等人,2025年)。
这些研究主要改进了代理人对任务反馈的探索和学习。 VISTA解决了重新利用勘探发现的东西这一补充问题:同一投入推出的视觉观测成为对代理人决定的共同监督。

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation trains on student-generated responses, and self-distillation can obtain stronger supervision by conditioning the same model on additional information ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Vision-OPD and Imagine-OPD exploit regional evidence, while Visual-OPSD transfers the benefit of generated visual thoughts ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
VA-OPD, V-Zero, and VCSD use visual dependence or contrastive evidence to refine the distillation signal ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) .
Context- and skill-conditioned approaches also distill trajectory experience for language models and agents ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) . VISTA focuses on visual experience acquired collectively through active interaction: CVED aligns this evidence with student decisions, and HAPI distinguishes reinforcement of successful behavior from distillation on unsuccessful attempts.
Appendix F provides a detailed discussion.

关于学生生成的响应的政策蒸馏列车,以及自我蒸馏,可以通过附加信息对同一模型进行调制来获得更强大的监督(Agarwal等人,2023年;Zhao等人,2026年).
Vision-OPD和Imagine-OPD利用区域证据,而Visual-OPSD则转移了产生的视觉思想的好处(袁等人,2026年;蔡等人,2026年;李等人,2026年).
VA-OPD,V-Zero,VCSD使用视觉依赖性或对比性证据来精炼蒸馏信号(刘等人,2026年;孙等人,2026年;梁等人,2026年).
以背景和技能为条件的方法还提取了语言模型和剂的轨迹经验(Ye等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026a年)。 VISTA专注于通过主动互动集体获得的视觉经验:CVED将这一证据与学生的决定相配合,HAPI将成功行为的强化与不成功的尝试的蒸馏区分开来.

blocks.en:
VISTA turns the visual experience of an on-policy rollout group into supervision for an individual agent.
Its two components address complementary aspects of this learning problem. CVED constructs a decision-aligned teacher from the group’s interaction experience, providing distributional guidance on the student’s own responses. HAPI determines how this guidance is used, reinforcing successful trajectories with RLVR and applying collective-experience distillation to unsuccessful ones.

VISTA将政策推出小组的视觉经验转化为对个别代理人的监督。
其两个部分涉及这一学习问题的补充方面。 CVED从小组的互动经验中搭建了一个决策协调教师,为学生自己的反应提供分布指导. HAPI决定如何使用这种指导,用RLVR加强成功的轨迹,并将集体经验蒸馏应用于失败的轨迹.

blocks.en: 3.2 Collective Visual Experience Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.2 集体视觉经验扭曲

blocks.en:
A rollout group provides several attempts to acquire evidence about the same input.
Their value is not limited to the final answers.
A trajectory may reveal a small visual detail that its peers missed, or obtain a useful observation before making a subsequent reasoning error. CVED compiles these discoveries into a task-local experience object ℰ x = 𝒞 ⁡ ( ℬ x ) \mathcal{E}_{x}=\mathcal{C}(\mathcal{B}_{x}) .
It associates each visual artifact with the decision that produced it and preserves its position within the originating interaction.
Relations between artifacts retain how successive crops were derived from one another and which regions they cover.
Repeated views can share a visual representation without losing their separate trajectory occurrences.
This organization lets the teacher interpret a visual discovery in context rather than treating the group as an unordered collection of images.
Trajectory outcomes provide feedback for interpreting this experience, while both successful and unsuccessful attempts remain eligible evidence sources.

blocks.en: 3.3 Heterogeneity-Aware Policy Improvement
blocks.zh: 3.3 异质性-知情政策改进

blocks.en:
Trajectories within a rollout group differ in both behavioral quality and informational value.
An unsuccessful attempt may discover useful visual evidence even when its subsequent decisions lead to an incorrect answer, whereas a successful attempt provides behavior supported by a verified outcome.
These differences motivate distinct forms of policy improvement.
While CVED makes experience available across the group, HAPI determines how each trajectory learns from it.
blocks.zh:
推出组内的轨迹在行为质量和信息价值上都不同.
一次不成功的尝试可能发现有用的视觉证据,即使其随后的决定导致错误的答案,而一次成功的尝试则提供了得到核实的结果支持的行为.
这些差异促使人们采取不同形式的政策改进。
虽然CVED提供整个组的经验,但HAPI决定每个轨迹如何从中学习.

blocks.en:
HAPI reinforces successful trajectories through outcome-based policy optimization and applies experience-guided distillation to unsuccessful ones.
For successful trajectories, the verified reward supports strengthening behavior that already solves the task.
For unsuccessful trajectories, the experience-conditioned teacher provides distributional guidance informed by discoveries beyond the agent’s local history.
This guidance covers the full sequence of generated responses, allowing collective experience to inform intermediate decisions as well as the final answer.
Both types of trajectory remain sources of collective experience, irrespective of the objective applied to their behavior.
blocks.zh:

对于成功的轨迹,经过验证的奖励支持已经解决了任务的强化行为.
对于不成功的轨迹,有经验的教师提供分布性指导,以了解超出其当地历史的发现。
本指南涵盖所产生答复的全部序列,使集体经验能够为中间决定和最后答案提供信息。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
Our evaluation examines the effectiveness of collective visual experience and the roles of its two components.
We first compare VISTA with existing agents, examine generalization across task families under different training methods, and then isolate the contributions of CVED and HAPI.
Further analyses examine teacher updates and distribution matching, generalization across backbones, and the effects of experience scale and distillation strength.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价审查了集体视觉经验的有效性及其两个组成部分的作用。
我们首先将VISTA与现有代理人进行比较,根据不同的培训方法审查任务家庭的概况,然后孤立CVED和HAPI的贡献.
进一步的分析考察了教师更新和分布匹配,跨骨干体的概括,以及经验规模和蒸馏强度的影响.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) as the default backbones and train on the Vision-OPD-6K split ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
Training inputs contain the original full image without target-box overlays and the question without added spatial-restriction hints; the student acquires additional observations through visual tools.
Our default configuration uses K = 8 K=8 rollouts per input, distillation weight λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , and an artifact budget of B = 4 B=4 for teacher-context construction.
Answer correctness provides the task reward, and the policy may answer directly without invoking a tool.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Qune3-VL-4B-Instruct和Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct(Bai等人,2025年)作为Vision-OPD-6K分机上的默认骨干和列车(袁等人,2026年).
训练投入包含原始全图像,没有目标框的覆盖,问题没有增加空间限制提示;学生通过视觉工具获得额外的观测.
我们的默认配置采用K=8 K=8的每次输入展开,蒸馏重量Q=0.1\lambda=0.1,以及用于师文建设的B=4 B=4的文物预算.
正确回答提供了任务奖励,政策可以直接回答,而不使用工具.

blocks.en:
The main evaluation covers V*Bench ( Wu and Xie, 2023 ) , ZoomBench ( Wei et al., 2026 ) , HR-Bench-4K/8K ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and the English and Chinese splits of MME-RealWorld ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
To assess whether improvements extend beyond fine-grained perception, the training-method comparison also includes MMStar, MMBench, and MathVista ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2024 ) .
Component ablations and parameter analyses use V*Bench and both HR-Bench variants unless otherwise specified.
We report accuracy (%) and the unweighted mean over the benchmarks in each table. Bold and underlined scores indicate the best and second-best results, respectively.
blocks.zh:
主要评价范围包括V*Bench(吴和谢,2023年),ZomoBench(Wei等人,2026年),HR-Bench-4K/8K(Wang等人,2025年b),以及MME-RealWorld的英中分法(Zhang等人,2025年b).
为了评估改进是否超出精细感知,培训方法比较还包括MMStar、MMBench和MathVista(Chen等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年;Lu等人,2024年)。
除非另有说明,组件分解和参数分析使用V*Bench和HR-Bench两种变体。
我们报告准确性(%)和未加权平均数高于各表的基准。 粗体和下划线的分数分别表明最佳和次最佳结果。

blocks.en:
We compare against the base checkpoint, GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , and OPSD, VCSD, Vision-OPD, and Imagine-OPD ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) .
Within each backbone, controlled comparisons share the starting checkpoint, training data, optimizer and schedule, with matched visual tools and interaction limits.
Evaluation is deterministic, and all experimental results are averaged over three seeds.
All reported results are obtained from our own experiments, including the broader comparison with thinking-with-images agents and general multimodal models; larger and proprietary models serve as capability references.
Appendix C provides the reference-model descriptions and further protocol details.
blocks.zh:
我们与基地检查站GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)和OPSD、VCSD、Visual-OPD和Imagine-OPD(赵等人,2026年;梁等人,2026年;袁等人,2026年;蔡等人,2026年)进行比较。
在每个主干范围内,控制下比较共享起始检查站、培训数据、优化器和时间表,并配有相应的视觉工具和互动限制。
评价具有确定性,所有实验结果均以3个种子为平均值.
所有报告的结果都是从我们自己的实验中获得的,包括更广泛地与思维和图像代理人和一般多式联运模型进行比较;更大的和专有模型作为能力参考。
附 录 C提供了参考模型描述和进一步的协议细节.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
VISTA improves on its base checkpoints across all six benchmarks at both scales (Table 1 ), with the largest gains on ZoomBench.
The improvements on both HR-Bench variants and both language splits of MME-RealWorld show that the benefit extends beyond a single visual-search benchmark.
Both variants also outperform the compared thinking-with-images baselines throughout the suite.
blocks.zh:
VISTA改进了所有六个基准的基准检查站(表1),在Zoom Bench上收益最大。
对HR-Bench变体和MME-RealWorld两种语言的分化的改进表明,这种好处超出了单一的视觉研究基准。
这两个变体也都超过了整个套房的比对思维和图像基线。

blocks.en:
The trained 4B model exceeds the base 8B checkpoint across this comparison, suggesting that better use of interaction experience can complement increases in model capacity.
Although the trained 8B model generally performs better, the consistent gains at both scales support collective experience as a useful source of supervision rather than a capacity-specific remedy.
blocks.zh:
训练有素的4B模型通过这次比较超过了基数8B检查点,这表明更好地利用互动经验可以补充模型能力的提高.
虽然训练有素的8B模式一般表现较好,但两个层面的一贯成果都支持集体经验,作为有用的监督来源,而不是针对能力的补救办法。

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Task Generalization
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨任务概述

blocks.en:
Generalization beyond fine-grained perception. Table 2 pairs fine-grained visual tasks with MMStar, MMBench, and MathVista to examine the breadth of the learned capabilities under fixed backbones. VISTA leads both task groups at 4B and 8B, with improvements in fine-grained perception accompanied by stronger general reasoning rather than a trade-off between them.
The result on MathVista further extends this pattern to mathematical reasoning in visual contexts.
blocks.zh:
普化超越精进观. 表2 配有MMStar,MMBench,和MathVista的细纹视觉任务,以检查固定骨干下学习能力的宽度. VISTA在4B和8B两个任务组中都领先,精细感知的改善伴随着更强大的一般推理而不是两者之间的权衡.
在MathVista上的结果进一步将这种模式扩展到视觉背景下的数学推理.

blocks.en:
Consistent gains across training methods and scales. GRPO and the competing distillation methods also improve over the base checkpoints, but their relative strengths vary across tasks.
In contrast, VISTA maintains its advantage on every evaluated benchmark at both scales.
This consistency supports cross-task generalization within the evaluated suite, rather than an average gain driven by one task family.
The ablations below distinguish the contributions of experience construction and supervision allocation.
blocks.zh:
各种培训方法和规模的持续收益。 GRPO和相互竞争的蒸馏方法也比基地检查站有所改善,但它们的相对优势因任务而异。
相比之下,VISTA在两个比额表的每个评价基准上都保持优势。
这种一致性支持在被评价的套间内跨任务概括,而不是由一个任务家族驱动的平均收益.
下文将区分经验建设和监管分配的贡献。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We isolate experience construction and supervision allocation on Qwen3-VL-4B.
The CVED ablation fixes HAPI and varies the teacher’s privileged context, whereas the HAPI ablation fixes CVED and varies the learning rule.
blocks.zh:
我们隔离了Quen3-VL-4B上的经验建设和监督分配。
校对:Portnoy

blocks.en:
Table 4 compares CVED with reference-answer supervision (Answer-only), annotated evidence crops (Oracle ROI), and trajectory-ordered observations and interaction records (Unstructured).
All variants use the same training set, and CVED and Unstructured share the selected observations and context budget.
CVED performs best across all three tasks, followed by Oracle ROI, Unstructured, and Answer-only.
blocks.zh:
表4将CVED与参考回答监督(Answer- only),注释证据作物(Oracle ROI),以及轨迹顺序观测和互动记录(Unstructured)进行比较.
所有变体都使用相同的训练集,CVED和Unstructured共享选定的观察和上下文预算.
CVED在所有三项任务中表现最好,其次是Oracle ROI, Unstructured, 以及只回答.

blocks.en:
The ordering suggests that the teacher benefits from visual evidence beyond knowing the correct endpoint, while the strength of Oracle ROI highlights the value of relevant, localized information.
CVED improves further by retaining interaction context and aligning evidence with the student’s decision.
Its advantage over Unstructured is particularly informative because the observations and budget are unchanged: organizing the evidence, rather than simply supplying more images, makes the supervision more effective.
Together with the Oracle ROI comparison, this suggests that localization and interaction context serve complementary roles: useful supervision depends on both the evidence presented and its relation to the decision being learned.
blocks.zh:
命令表明,教师除了知道正确的终点之外,还从视觉证据中受益,而Oracle ROI的实力凸显了相关,局部信息的价值.
CVED通过保留互动上下文和使证据与学生的决定保持一致而进一步改善.
它相对于非结构化的优势特别具有信息性,因为观察和预算没有改变:组织证据,而不是仅仅提供更多的图像,使监督更加有效.
与Oracle ROI的比较一起,这表明本地化和互动环境可以起到互补的作用:有益的监督既取决于所提供的证据,也取决于它与所学到的决定的关系.

blocks.en:
Table 4 compares GRPO-only, CVED-only, Uniform hybrid, and HAPI with the same rollout-group size and optimization budget.
Uniform hybrid applies both objectives to every trajectory, whereas HAPI reinforces successful trajectories and distills unsuccessful ones.
All distillation variants share the same CVED context construction.
blocks.zh:
表4将只限GRPO、只限CVED、统一混合型和HAPI与相同的推出组规模和优化预算进行比较。
统一混合法将两个目标应用于每个轨迹,而HAPI则强化成功的轨迹和蒸馏失败的轨迹。
所有蒸馏变体都具有相同的CVED上下文构造.

blocks.en:
Uniform hybrid outperforms either objective alone, and HAPI improves further across all three tasks.
Thus, reinforcement and distillation are complementary, but their allocation also matters.
Since Uniform hybrid already receives both signals, HAPI’s advantage supports matching supervision to trajectory outcomes rather than merely adding a loss term.
Meanwhile, unsuccessful attempts can still contribute useful observations to CVED, separating their informational value from how their behavior is optimized.
Thus, the routing rule changes how trajectories learn without restricting the shared evidence pool to successful attempts, preserving potentially useful discoveries from failures.
blocks.zh:
统一的混合性工作成绩要么仅次于目标,HAPI在所有三项任务中都得到了进一步改善。
因此,加固和蒸馏是相辅相成的,但其分配也很重要。
由于统一混合体已经收到两个信号,HAPI的优势是支持将监督与轨迹结果相匹配,而不仅仅是增加一个损失期。
同时,不成功的尝试仍然能够为CVED提供有用的观察,将其信息价值与行为优化方式区分开来.
因此,路线规则改变了轨迹的学习方式,不限制共享证据库为成功的尝试,保留了对失败的潜在有用发现.

blocks.en: 4.5 Training Design Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 培训设计分析

blocks.en:
We next examine two supporting choices within the fixed CVED–HAPI framework: how the teacher is updated and how its distributions are matched.
Both comparisons use Qwen3-VL-4B and the six-benchmark suite from Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将在固定的CVED-HAPI框架内审查两个支持性选择:如何更新教师及其分布匹配。
两种比较都使用Qune3-VL-4B和表1的六标套件.

blocks.en:
Freezing the teacher at initialization retains much of the performance of EMA (Table 5 ).
EMA gives the stronger average, especially on V*Bench and ZoomBench, while the frozen teacher performs better on HR-Bench-8K and MME-RW-CN.
We therefore adopt EMA as an aggregate preference rather than a uniformly better choice for every task.
blocks.zh:
在初始化时冻结教师保留了EMA的大部分性能(表5).
EMA给出了更强的平均值,特别是在V*Bench和ZoomBench,而冷冻的老师在HR-Bench-8K和MME-RW-CN上表现更好.
因此,我们把EMA作为总的偏好,而不是对每一项任务的一致更好的选择。

blocks.en:
Both teachers receive newly collected experience, so fixed weights do not imply a fixed teaching signal.
The competitive frozen-teacher result suggests that context enrichment can provide useful supervision in its own right, with parameter updates offering an additional, task-dependent benefit.
blocks.zh:
两位教师都获得了新收集的经验,因此固定的权重并不意味着固定的教学信号.
竞争性冻结教师结果表明,丰富环境本身可以提供有益的监督,参数更新可提供额外的、取决于任务的利益。

blocks.en:
We repeat the base, GRPO, OPSD, and VISTA comparisons on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) using the same protocol within each backbone (Table 7 ). VISTA leads on all three tasks for both backbones.
Its advantage over OPSD is concentrated on V*Bench at 4B, where the high-resolution results are close, but extends more clearly across the suite at 9B.

其相对于OPSD的优势集中在4B的V*Bench,高分辨率结果接近,但更清晰地延伸到9B的套房.

blocks.en:
On Qwen3.5-9B, OPSD is stronger than GRPO on V*Bench but weaker on the high-resolution tasks, whereas VISTA improves over both throughout.
The combined supervision therefore remains useful across the tested backbones and across tasks that favor different baseline objectives, although the size of the benefit depends on the model and task.

因此,在经过测试的骨干部门和有利于不同基线目标的任务中,综合监督仍然有用,尽管收益的规模取决于模式和任务。

blocks.en: 4.7 Scalability
blocks.zh: 4.7 可伸缩性

blocks.en:
Increasing the rollout-group size K ∈ { 4 , 6 , 8 , 12 , 16 } K\in\{4,6,8,12,16\} improves or preserves accuracy on all three benchmarks, with the strongest response on V*Bench (Figure 2 (a)).
Gains continue beyond the default group size but diminish toward the largest tested groups, indicating that additional attempts remain useful with decreasing returns.

收益继续超过默认的组数,但向受试最大的组数减少,这表明随着收益的减少,更多的尝试仍然有用。

blocks.en:
Because the artifact budget is fixed, larger groups expand the candidate experience pool without requiring the teacher to process every new observation.
Together with the budget sweep below, this favors collecting broadly and conditioning selectively.
The sweep also increases rollout volume, so it measures scaling with additional experience rather than a fixed-compute allocation.
In particular, the different trends for K K and B B suggest that the supply of candidate evidence and the teacher’s capacity to use it should be treated as separate design choices.

特别是KK和BB的不同趋势表明,应把提供候选证据和教师使用证据的能力作为单独的设计选择。

blocks.en:
Having varied the experience pool, we examine how strongly that experience should supervise the student and how much should enter each teacher context.
We vary λ \lambda and B B independently on Qwen3-VL-4B, keeping the other settings at their defaults.

Every tested nonzero weight improves all three tasks over this zero-distillation setting, while the shared peak at λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 favors a moderate distillation strength.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We reframed grouped active-agent training as an experience-internalization problem.
Instead of using on-policy rollouts only to estimate scalar advantages, VISTA constructs collective visual experience through CVED and uses HAPI to combine successful-behavior reinforcement with experience-guided distillation on unsuccessful trajectories.
The deployed agent remains a single ordinary tool-using policy.
This view makes experience sources, interaction structure, and outcome feedback independently testable components of privileged supervision.
More broadly, it suggests that the transient population created by on-policy training can serve as a renewable source of experience for the policy itself.
Appendix G discusses limitations and directions for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们重新确定了主动代理培训作为一个经验-内部化问题。
VISTA不只利用政策上推出来估计scalar的优点,而是通过CVED构建集体的视觉体验,并利用HAPI将成功行为强化与经验引导的蒸馏结合到不成功的轨迹上.
部署的代理人仍然是单一的普通工具使用政策。
这种观点使经验来源,互动结构和结果反馈成为特权监督的可独立检验的组成部分.
更广泛地说,它表明,通过政策培训创造的瞬息万变的人口可以成为政策本身的可再生经验来源。

blocks.en: B.1 Experience Representation and Projection
blocks.zh: B.1 经验说明和预测

blocks.en:
The compiler retains decision records and artifact occurrences before applying a teacher-context budget.
Canonical artifact clusters share representative images while retaining each occurrence’s source trajectory and producing decision.
Nested crops are mapped to input-image coordinates. Exact duplicates are merged; near-duplicate observations are merged when their root-coordinate box IoU is at least 0.90 0.90 or their perceptual-hash Hamming distance is at most 4 4 .
The internal graph stores temporal, provenance, derivation, and spatial relations for teacher-context construction.

汇编者在应用教师编译预算之前保留裁决记录和文物。
木制文物集群分享有代表性的图像,同时保留每个事件的源轨迹并作出决策。
巢状作物被映射到输入图像坐标. 精确的重复被合并;当其根坐标框IoU至少0.90 0.90或者其知觉-hash Hamming距离最多为4 4 时,近重复观测被合并.
内部图中存储着时间、来源、衍生和空间关系,用于师文建筑。

blocks.en:
Experience is compiled once per input, with a separate projected view for each decision.
Selection prioritizes student-visible and peer evidence, favors successful-peer observations, and deprioritizes future-only observations from the target trajectory.
Visual ancestors are included within the artifact budget.
Alignment marks student-visible, peer-only, and future-self evidence, while caching avoids repeated projection and image processing.

选择优先选择学生可见和同行证据,偏好成功对等的观察,并且将目标轨迹中仅未来的观察去优先排序.

校对标记是学生可见的,对等的,以及未来的自我证据,而缓存则避免了重复的投影和图像处理.

blocks.en:
The budget counts distinct selected crop artifacts, including their required crop ancestors; the original input image is already present in the student’s history.
The projector starts with an empty selected set and greedily adds a candidate together with its unselected ancestors, rejecting additions that would exceed B B .
For each candidate, the decision-conditioned score combines student visibility, the fraction of source trajectories that are peers, the fraction of those peers that succeeded, spatial novelty, newly covered source trajectories, and inverse source frequency.
Their coefficients are 6 6 , 4 4 , 2 2 , 1.5 1.5 , 0.5 0.5 , and 0.5 0.5 , respectively; future-only evidence from the target trajectory receives a penalty of 2 2 .
Spatial novelty is one minus the largest root-coordinate IoU with an already selected artifact, or one when the selected set is empty.
The score is divided by the number of new artifacts required by the candidate’s ancestor closure.
Ties are resolved by greater spatial novelty, fewer added artifacts, and then the smaller artifact identifier.
Selection stops when the budget is exhausted or no feasible addition remains.
If all artifacts fit, the complete set is retained. Only decisions producing selected artifacts and relations whose endpoints remain visible are serialized into the projected view.

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the default backbones ( Bai et al., 2025 ) .
Within each backbone, trainable methods start from the same checkpoint and use the Vision-OPD-6K training split ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , which contains 6,241 image–question–answer examples.
The training inputs use the original full images without overlaid target boxes. Questions contain no added instructions that identify a target region or restrict attention to an annotated spatial region.
The student therefore chooses where to inspect from the image and task question, rather than following a supplied localization hint.
Reference answers are retained for reward verification, not appended to the student’s input. Regional annotations are used only for training-time privileged supervision in the relevant baselines and the Oracle ROI ablation.
The default configuration uses K = 8 K=8 trajectories per input, distillation weight λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , and visual artifact budget B = 4 B=4 .
Controlled comparisons share the optimizer and training schedule, with matched rollout settings, visual tools, and interaction limits.

blocks.en:
The CVED ablation keeps the training inputs and HAPI learning rule unchanged.
Answer-only supplies the reference answer to the teacher in place of visual interaction experience; the reference answer is not appended to the student history.
Oracle ROI supplies annotated region crops as teacher-side visual evidence, without drawing boxes on the student’s full image or adding localization instructions to its question.
Unstructured and CVED use the same selected observations and context budget. Unstructured presents observations and interaction records in trajectory order, whereas CVED retains artifact relations and decision-relative alignment.
Consequently, the privileged input changes on the teacher side without changing the image–question task solved by the student.

只答为老师提供参考答案,代替视觉互动体验;参考答案不附在学生历史中.
Oracle ROI提供附加注释的区域作物作为教师侧视证据,而不在学生的完整形象上画盒子,也不在问题中添加本地化指示.
非结构化和CVED使用相同的选定意见和上下文预算. 无结构的显示观测和相互作用记录按轨迹顺序排列,而CVED则保留了文物关系和决策关系对齐.

blocks.en:
Table 10 compares hindsight from the student’s own trajectory with collective visual experience from the rollout group.
Self-only hindsight restricts candidate visual observations and their interaction records to the target trajectory, including observations acquired later in that trajectory.
Collective visual experience uses the full group’s observations and interaction records, as in the default CVED configuration.
Both settings retain the same group-level categorical outcome-feedback records, HAPI routing, teacher updates, and context-serialization format.
The comparison uses Qwen3-VL-4B with K = 8 K=8 , λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , and the same artifact-budget cap B = 4 B=4 , following the training and evaluation protocol in Appendix C .
This contrast tests the added value of peer visual experience beyond the target trajectory’s own hindsight under shared outcome feedback.
blocks.zh:
表10将学生自身轨迹的后照与推出小组的集体视觉经验进行比较。
自我独占的后视将候选视觉观测及其交互记录限制在目标轨迹,包括后来在该轨迹中获得的观测.
集体视觉体验使用完整组的观测和交互记录,如默认的CVED配置.
两个设置都保留了相同的组级绝对结果反馈记录,HAPI路由,教师更新,以及上下文序列化格式.
该比较采用Qune3-VL-4B与K=8K=8,Q=0.1\lambda=0.1,并沿用附录C中的培训和评价规程,采用相同的文物预算封顶B=4B=4.
这一对比测试了同行视觉经验在共享结果反馈下超出目标轨迹自身后视值的附加值.

blocks.en:
Collective visual experience improves average accuracy from 81.70% to 83.83%, a gain of 2.13 percentage points over self-only hindsight.
The gains are positive on all three benchmarks: 3.14 points on V*Bench, 1.25 on HR-Bench-4K, and 2.00 on HR-Bench-8K.
With categorical outcome feedback available in both settings, this comparison supports the value of peer visual observations and their interaction context beyond evidence acquired within the target trajectory.

集体视觉体验提高了平均精度,从81.70%提高到83.83%,比自足后视提高2.13个百分点.
所有三项基准都取得了积极的进展:V* Bench的3.14分、HR-Bench-4K的1.25分和HR-Bench-8K的2.00分。
在两种情况下都有绝对的结果反馈,这种比较支持同行视觉观测的价值及其在目标轨迹内获得的证据以外的相互作用。

blocks.en: Appendix E Disentangling HAPI Routing
blocks.zh: 附录 E HAPI 运行

blocks.en:
Table 11 crosses the trajectory subsets used for reinforcement and distillation.
The RL mask restricts reinforcement to successful trajectories, while the distillation mask restricts CVED to unsuccessful trajectories, including invalid and incomplete attempts.
The two intermediate settings apply one mask at a time; HAPI applies both.
All four settings construct CVED context from the complete rollout group and use Qwen3-VL-4B with K = 8 K=8 , λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 , and B = 4 B=4 .
Relative advantages are computed from the full group, and the policy term retains the full-group response-token denominator N N .
The distillation term averages over response tokens in its eligible subset, following the learning-rule definitions in Appendix B.3 .
The teacher updates, optimizer, training schedule, and evaluation protocol are shared across settings.
The crossed comparison tests the contribution of each routing mask and their combination under these loss-normalization conventions.

表11横跨用于加固和蒸馏的轨迹子集.
RL口罩将加固限制为成功轨迹,而蒸馏口罩则将CVED限制为不成功的轨迹,包括无效和不完整的尝试.
两个中间设置一次应用一个口罩;HAPI同时应用.
所有四个设置都从完整的推出组中构建CVED上下文,使用Qwen3-VL-4B,其中K=8K=8,QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1,B=4B=4.

按照附录B.3中的学习规则定义,蒸馏词在符合条件的子集中相对于反应符号的平均值。

交叉比较测试了每个路由罩在这些损耗正常化公约下的贡献及其组合。

blocks.en:
Neither mask alone improves average accuracy over the uniform hybrid.
Restricting RL to successful trajectories lowers the average from 82.87% to 82.55%, while restricting distillation to unsuccessful trajectories leaves it essentially unchanged at 82.87%.
Both individual masks produce mixed changes across benchmarks.
Applying the two masks together yields the highest accuracy on every benchmark and raises the average to 83.83%, 0.96 percentage points above the uniform hybrid.
This pattern supports the joint allocation of reinforcement and distillation under the stated normalization conventions, with the benefit of each routing choice depending on the other.
blocks.zh:
单靠面具并不能提高统一混合体的平均准确性。
将RL限制在成功的轨迹上,平均从82.87%降至82.55%,而将蒸馏限制在不成功的轨迹上,则基本不变,为82.87%。
两种口罩都造成不同基准的混合变化。
将两个口罩加在一起,每个基准的准确度最高,平均提高到83.83%,比统一混合体高出0.96个百分点。
这种模式支持根据宣布的正常化公约共同分配加固和提炼,根据不同情况选择每一路线。

blocks.en: Appendix F Additional Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 有关工作

blocks.en: F.1 RLVR for Multimodal Agents
blocks.zh: F.1 多式联运代理公司

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides a way to learn visual tool use from task outcomes rather than requiring demonstrations for every intermediate action.
DeepEyes learns active perception through end-to-end reinforcement learning without a cold-start supervised fine-tuning stage ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) .
VTool-R1 integrates Python-based visual editing into reinforcement fine-tuning, allowing models to learn multimodal reasoning chains under task-accuracy rewards ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Visual-ARFT extends agentic reinforcement fine-tuning to image manipulation and web search ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
Thyme learns to generate executable code for image processing and computation ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , while DeepEyesV2 combines cold-start training with reinforcement learning for multimodal tool use ( Hong et al., 2025 ) .
Together, these studies shift multimodal policy learning from reasoning over a fixed visual input toward acquiring new evidence during interaction.
blocks.zh:
以可核查的奖励加强学习,提供了从任务结果中学习视觉工具的方法,而不是要求每个中间行动进行演示。
DeepEyes通过端到端强化学习学习积极感知,没有冷启动监督微调阶段(郑等人,2025年).
VTool-R1 集成软件 基于Python的视觉编辑成为强化微调,让模型在任务精确性奖励下学习多式联运推理链(Wu等人,2025年).
Visual-ARFT扩展代理强化微调到图像操纵和网络搜索(Liu等人,2025年).
Thyme学习生成图像处理和计算可执行代码(Zhang等人,2025a),DeepEyesV2则将冷启动培训与多模式工具使用的强化学习结合起来(Hong等人,2025年).
这些研究共同将多式联运政策学习从固定视觉投入的推理转向在互动过程中获取新证据。

blocks.en:
Subsequent developments refine how visual actions are explored and evaluated.
Pixel Reasoner combines instruction tuning with curiosity-driven reinforcement learning to encourage the use of pixel-space operations ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
MAPO addresses the mismatch between textual reasoning and visual actions by incorporating description–observation alignment into advantage estimation ( Yang et al., 2026b ) .
Mini-o3 scales visual search through diverse reasoning patterns and longer tool interactions ( Lai et al., 2025 ) .
Where these approaches improve exploration or reward-based credit assignment, VISTA focuses on transferring the observations produced by exploration.
It treats a same-input rollout group as a source of collective visual experience and turns discoveries across trajectories into decision-aligned supervision for the policy.
blocks.zh:
随后的发展改进了视觉行动的探索和评价。
Pixel Reasoner将指令调谐与好奇驱动的强化学习结合起来,以鼓励使用像素空间操作(Wang等人,2025a). 。 。 。
MAPO处理文字推理和视觉动作之间的不匹配问题,将描述-观察对齐纳入优势估计(Yang等人,2026b)。
迷你-o3通过多种推理模式和更长的工具交互作用来进行视觉搜索(Lai等人,2025年).
如果这些方法改进了勘探或基于奖励的信贷分配,VISTA则侧重于转移勘探所产生的观测结果。
它将同一投入的推出小组视为集体视觉经验的来源,并将跨轨迹的发现转化为政策的决策协调监督。

blocks.en: F.2 OPD for Multimodal Agents
blocks.zh: F.2 多式联运代理业务方案

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation provides teacher supervision along responses generated by the student, reducing the distribution mismatch associated with fixed teacher-generated sequences ( Agarwal et al., 2023 ) .
On-policy self-distillation uses the same model as teacher and student with different contexts, allowing privileged information to provide a stronger teaching signal ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Penaloza et al., 2026 ) .
On-Policy Context Distillation demonstrates how a context-conditioned teacher can transfer experiential knowledge into a language model through this mechanism ( Ye et al., 2026 ) .
For language agents, OPID extracts hierarchical skill guidance from completed on-policy trajectories ( Yang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
政策蒸馏提供教师监督学生的反应,减少与固定教师生成序列相关的分配不匹配(Agarwal等人,2023年)。
政策上的自我消化使用与背景不同的师生相同的模式,允许特权信息提供更强的教学信号(赵等人,2026年;佩诺莎等人,2026年).
政策背景的扭曲表明,有环境条件的教师如何通过这一机制将经验知识转移到语言模型(Ye等人,2026年)。
对于语言代理人,业务信息开发办公室从已完成的政策轨迹中摘录等级技能指导(Yang等人,2026a) 。 。 。

blocks.en:
For multimodal learning, Vision-OPD matches a full-image student’s next-token distributions to those of a crop-conditioned teacher along student-generated rollouts ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
Imagine-OPD conditions the teacher on annotated regional evidence to supervise tool-free imagination trajectories ( Cai et al., 2026 ) .
Visual-OPSD instead conditions the teacher on generated visual-thought traces and distills their reasoning benefit into a student that does not generate those visual thoughts at inference ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
These approaches show how a richer visual context can improve a student without retaining that context at deployment.
blocks.zh:
在多模式学习方面,Vision-OPD在学生推出课程时,将学生的近代图象分布与有作物条件的教师分布相匹配(袁等人,2026年)。
Imagine-OPD为教师提供了附加说明的区域证据,以监督无工具的想象轨迹(Cai等人,2026年)。
反之,Visual-OPSD则为教师提供产生视觉思维的痕迹的条件,并将其推理好处提炼成一个不会在推论中产生这些视觉思维的学生(Li等人,2026年)。
这些方法表明,一个更丰富的视觉环境如何可以改善学生,而不在部署时保留这种环境。

blocks.en:
Other work focuses on the selectivity of visual supervision.
VA-OPD measures the teacher’s dependence on fine-grained visual detail and uses this visual advantage for rollout reweighting and token-grouped distillation ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
V-Zero contrasts question-relevant regional evidence with a negative visual view to gate distillation on student-sampled trajectories ( Sun et al., 2026 ) .
VCSD instead contrasts the original image with a content-erased control to construct visually grounded targets without privileged answers or evidence crops ( Liang et al., 2026 ) . VISTA addresses a different learning problem: internalizing visual experience discovered collectively through active interaction. CVED assembles this experience from same-input rollouts and aligns it with the student’s actual decisions. HAPI uses trajectory outcomes to distinguish reward-based reinforcement of successful behavior from experience-guided distillation on failed attempts, rather than reweighting distillation solely by visual dependence or contrastive evidence.
blocks.zh:
其他工作的重点是视觉监督的选择性。
VA-OPD衡量老师对精细的视觉细节的依赖,并利用这种视觉优势推出重量和符号组合的蒸馏(Liu等人,2026年).
V-Zero对比了与问题相关的区域证据,对学生抽样的轨迹上的闸门蒸馏有负面的视差(Sun等人,2026年) .
反之,VCSD则将原始图像与内容时代的控制作对比,以构建没有特权答案或证据作物的视基目标(Liang等人,2026年)。 VISTA解决了一个不同的学习问题:将通过积极互动集体发现的视觉体验内部化. CVED从同一投入的推出中收集了这一经验,并与学生的实际决定保持一致。 HAPI使用轨迹结果来区分成功行为的奖励强化与失败尝试上的经验制导蒸馏,而不是仅仅通过视觉依赖或对比性证据来重新加权蒸馏.

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: VISTA offers several directions for further development. First, the value of collective experience depends on the diversity and relevance of the group’s observations; adaptive exploration and evidence selection could improve supervision when rollouts are redundant or miss useful regions. Second, HAPI uses terminal outcomes to route supervision, motivating finer-grained feedback that distinguishes productive intermediate decisions from unsuccessful ones. Third, experience construction and teacher inference introduce additional training overhead; more compact experience representations and selective teacher queries could improve efficiency, with comparisons under matched total compute budgets clarifying the trade-offs. Finally, our evaluation focuses on image-question answering with crop-and-zoom interaction and Qwen-family backbones. Extending this framework to other model families, video, and broader tool-use environments would help assess its generality.
blocks.zh: VISTA为进一步发展提供了几个方向. 第一,集体经验的价值取决于小组观察的多样性和相关性;在推出多余或错过有用区域时,适应性的探索和证据选择可以改进监督。 第二,HAPI利用终端结果进行路由监督,激发精细的反馈,将生产性中间决定与失败决定区分开来. 第三,经验建设和教师推论引入了额外的培训间接费用;更紧凑的经验表述和有选择的教师询问可以提高效率,在相应的总计算预算下进行比较,澄清取舍。 最后,我们评价的重点是用作物和区间互动和Quen-family骨干来回答图像问题。 将这一框架扩大到其他示范家庭、视频和更广泛的工具使用环境将有助于评估其普遍性。
